data.narrative:
Pano AI is a Series B-stage Climate & Energy company founded by Sonia Kastner and Arvind Satyam that has raised $89M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer set of 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy), supplemented by reference to 8 additional private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchored to the company's last known post-money of $500M, applies a typical Series B-to-next-stage multiplier of 1.9x, implying a valuation of $950M. Peer-median analysis across the 3-company comparable set yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $700M to $3.0B. The peer-median method carries somewhat higher confidence given direct market comparables at similar or adjacent development stages.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $808M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $975M. The convergence between stage-progression and peer-median methodologies strengthens conviction in the mid-range estimate. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion in peer valuations ($700M to $3.0B), reflecting heterogeneity in technology maturity and go-to-market traction within the Climate & Energy sector, and the absence of Pano AI's most recent operational or financing metrics.
